decisions.reason: The accelerator is more peripheral than the firm's machinery core, but the firm's growth, R&D orientation, and available slack make it plausible to retain it as a learning and partnership vehicle for now.

The bitumen binder appears furthest from the firm's core equipment-and-systems business and customer base, so if early results fall short of aspirations management is likely to reallocate resources to closer recycling technologies.

The infectious-waste decontamination plant is close to the established offer, visibly promoted at launch, and fits the firm's capabilities in modular waste-treatment systems, so it is likely to be given more time in the market.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant is highly aligned with the firm's decentralized recycling strategy and manufacturing know-how, making it the least likely of the new products to be withdrawn soon.
